**Severity:** error · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Target helper re-exports are not supported; use a direct named import
```

## How to fix

Do not re-export from @rivetjs/runtime/dom|server; import the helper by name where it is used.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export { clientEffect } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
```

```tsx prefer
import { clientEffect } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
clientEffect(() => {});
```
